claims.text: Simply avoiding the use of sensitive features is insufficient for eliminating biases in algorithmic determinations.
Biases persist in determinations when sensitive features are excluded due to the indirect influence of sensitive information.
Fairness-aware learning can be achieved via a regularization approach applicable to any prediction algorithm with probabilistic discriminative models.

evidence.description: They have shown that simply avoiding the use of sensitive features is insufficient for eliminating biases in determinations...
...due to the indirect influence of sensitive information.
We then propose a regularization approach that is applicable to any prediction algorithm with probabilistic discriminative models.

methodologies.name: Fairness-aware Regularization for Probabilistic Discriminative Models
methodologies.description: A regularization approach designed to enforce social fairness by hiding sensitive information influence, applicable to probabilistic discriminative algorithms such as logistic regression.

limitations.text: Simply avoiding the use of sensitive features is insufficient for eliminating biases due to the indirect influence of sensitive information.
